config.question: What is the main purpose of this email?

options.label: Billing
options.description: A customer asks about an invoice, payment, charge, refund, or subscription bill.

options.label: Feature request
options.description: A user requests a new product feature, capability, integration, or improvement.

options.label: Other
options.description: A personal, internal, scheduling, or informational message unrelated to product support, billing, purchasing, feature requests, or spam.

options.label: Sales
options.description: A prospective customer asks about buying the product, pricing, a demo, licensing, or evaluating it for purchase.

options.label: Spam
options.description: Unsolicited junk email, phishing, scams, fake prizes, or get-rich-quick offers.

options.label: Support
options.description: A customer needs help fixing a product or account problem, such as errors, broken features, or access trouble.
